title: Gather Thy Children” and “Jim the Wonder Dog
seo_title: Carmichael Film Showing Fundraiser at B&B Theater, Lebanon
description: B&B Theater will show Dr. Bruce Carmichael's films "Gather Thy Children" and "Jim the Wonder Dog" as a fundraiser for the Benton Log Cabin. T-shirts will be available for purchase and donations are accepted. It takes place Sunday, November 15, 2026, from 3:00 to 5:00 PM at 925 S Jefferson Ave. in Lebanon, MO.
